title: Resources
description: Memory, CPU and disk: physical use and the scheduler's view.

options.content:
**Two views of the same memory.** *Physical*: what the kernel sees, out of the node's real RAM. *Scheduler*: what is promised: k3s's reserve (kubeReserved + the eviction threshold, `capacity − allocatable`) plus the pods' requests, which VPA sets. The scheduler does not place a pod that does not fit.

Other dashboards show over 100 % because they divide the whole node's usage (k3s included) by *allocatable*, the part left for pods after k3s's reserve. Here everything is out of the physical RAM.

panels.title: Physical RAM
panels.description: RAM the three nodes' kernels see (a CX23's 4 GB minus what the kernel keeps for itself).

targets.expr: sum(sum by (node) (label_replace(node_memory_MemTotal_bytes, "internal_ip", "$1", "instance", "([^:]+):.*") * on (internal_ip) group_left (node) max by (internal_ip, node) (kube_node_info)))

panels.title: Used now
panels.description: Physical RAM in use (MemTotal − MemAvailable): pods, k3s, the system, unreclaimable caches.

targets.expr: sum((sum by (node) (label_replace(node_memory_MemTotal_bytes, "internal_ip", "$1", "instance", "([^:]+):.*") * on (internal_ip) group_left (node) max by (internal_ip, node) (kube_node_info)) - sum by (node) (label_replace(node_memory_MemAvailable_bytes, "internal_ip", "$1", "instance", "([^:]+):.*") * on (internal_ip) group_left (node) max by (internal_ip, node) (kube_node_info)))) / sum(sum by (node) (label_replace(node_memory_MemTotal_bytes, "internal_ip", "$1", "instance", "([^:]+):.*") * on (internal_ip) group_left (node) max by (internal_ip, node) (kube_node_info)))

panels.title: k3s uses
panels.description: Working set of the cgroup k3s.service on all three nodes: k3s (apiserver, etcd, controllers, kubelet) and containerd. kubeReserved is sized by the same number.

targets.expr: sum(max by (node) (container_memory_working_set_bytes{job="kubelet",systemd_service="k3s"}))

panels.title: Reserved for k3s
panels.description: capacity − allocatable on all nodes: kubeReserved (1750Mi each, hosts/cloud-init.yaml) plus the eviction threshold (100Mi each).

targets.expr: sum((sum by (node) (kube_node_status_capacity{resource="memory"}) - sum by (node) (kube_node_status_allocatable{resource="memory"})))

panels.title: Pods requested (VPA)
panels.description: Pods' memory requests (set by VPA) out of allocatable. Over 100 % only while a pod carries a resize kubelet refused (left from VPA's former in-place mode; gone when the pod is recreated).

targets.expr: sum(sum by (node) (((kube_pod_container_resource_requests{resource="memory",node!=""} * on (namespace, pod) group_left () max by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_status_phase{phase=~"Pending|Running"} == 1)) or (kube_pod_init_container_resource_requests{resource="memory",node!=""} * on (namespace, pod, container) group_left () max by (namespace, pod, container) (kube_pod_init_container_info{restart_policy="Always"}) * on (namespace, pod) group_left () max by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_status_phase{phase=~"Pending|Running"} == 1))))) / sum(sum by (node) (kube_node_status_allocatable{resource="memory"}))

panels.title: Fits after losing a node?
panels.description: Pods' requests out of the allocatable of the two remaining nodes. Over 100 %: when a node dies, some pods stay Pending (alert KubeMemoryOvercommit). Lowest priority tiers go first.

targets.expr: sum(sum by (node) (((kube_pod_container_resource_requests{resource="memory",node!=""} * on (namespace, pod) group_left () max by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_status_phase{phase=~"Pending|Running"} == 1)) or (kube_pod_init_container_resource_requests{resource="memory",node!=""} * on (namespace, pod, container) group_left () max by (namespace, pod, container) (kube_pod_init_container_info{restart_policy="Always"}) * on (namespace, pod) group_left () max by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_status_phase{phase=~"Pending|Running"} == 1))))) / (sum(sum by (node) (kube_node_status_allocatable{resource="memory"})) - max(sum by (node) (kube_node_status_allocatable{resource="memory"})))

panels.title: Physical: what uses the RAM
panels.description: Pods: working set of all containers. k3s: the cgroup k3s.service (k3s and containerd). System: the rest of what is used. Available: what the kernel can still hand out (MemAvailable, includes reclaimable cache). The bar is the node's physical RAM.

targets.expr: sum by (node) (container_memory_working_set_bytes{container!="",pod!=""})
max by (node) (container_memory_working_set_bytes{job="kubelet",systemd_service="k3s"})

clamp_min((sum by (node) (label_replace(node_memory_MemTotal_bytes, "internal_ip", "$1", "instance", "([^:]+):.*") * on (internal_ip) group_left (node) max by (internal_ip, node) (kube_node_info)) - sum by (node) (label_replace(node_memory_MemAvailable_bytes, "internal_ip", "$1", "instance", "([^:]+):.*") * on (internal_ip) group_left (node) max by (internal_ip, node) (kube_node_info))) - sum by (node) (container_memory_working_set_bytes{container!="",pod!=""}) - max by (node) (container_memory_working_set_bytes{job="kubelet",systemd_service="k3s"}), 0)
sum by (node) (label_replace(node_memory_MemAvailable_bytes, "internal_ip", "$1", "instance", "([^:]+):.*") * on (internal_ip) group_left (node) max by (internal_ip, node) (kube_node_info))

panels.title: Scheduler: what is promised
panels.description: k3s reserve: kubeReserved + eviction threshold. Pods' requests: what VPA set, of running pods (native sidecars included, completed pods left out). Free for new pods: what the scheduler can still place. The bar is the node's capacity, the same RAM as on the left; a bar longer than that: a pod carries a resize kubelet refused.

targets.expr: (sum by (node) (kube_node_status_capacity{resource="memory"}) - sum by (node) (kube_node_status_allocatable{resource="memory"}))

sum by (node) (((kube_pod_container_resource_requests{resource="memory",node!=""} * on (namespace, pod) group_left () max by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_status_phase{phase=~"Pending|Running"} == 1)) or (kube_pod_init_container_resource_requests{resource="memory",node!=""} * on (namespace, pod, container) group_left () max by (namespace, pod, container) (kube_pod_init_container_info{restart_policy="Always"}) * on (namespace, pod) group_left () max by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_status_phase{phase=~"Pending|Running"} == 1))))

clamp_min(sum by (node) (kube_node_status_allocatable{resource="memory"}) - sum by (node) (((kube_pod_container_resource_requests{resource="memory",node!=""} * on (namespace, pod) group_left () max by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_status_phase{phase=~"Pending|Running"} == 1)) or (kube_pod_init_container_resource_requests{resource="memory",node!=""} * on (namespace, pod, container) group_left () max by (namespace, pod, container) (kube_pod_init_container_info{restart_policy="Always"}) * on (namespace, pod) group_left () max by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_status_phase{phase=~"Pending|Running"} == 1)))), 0)

panels.title: Per node, in numbers
panels.description: The bars above as numbers. Left half: physical use (sums to Physical RAM). Right half: the scheduler's view (k3s reserve + Allocatable = Physical RAM). Free for new pods below zero: a pod carries a resize kubelet refused.

targets.expr: sum by (node) (label_replace(node_memory_MemTotal_bytes, "internal_ip", "$1", "instance", "([^:]+):.*") * on (internal_ip) group_left (node) max by (internal_ip, node) (kube_node_info))
sum by (node) (container_memory_working_set_bytes{container!="",pod!=""})
max by (node) (container_memory_working_set_bytes{job="kubelet",systemd_service="k3s"})

clamp_min((sum by (node) (label_replace(node_memory_MemTotal_bytes, "internal_ip", "$1", "instance", "([^:]+):.*") * on (internal_ip) group_left (node) max by (internal_ip, node) (kube_node_info)) - sum by (node) (label_replace(node_memory_MemAvailable_bytes, "internal_ip", "$1", "instance", "([^:]+):.*") * on (internal_ip) group_left (node) max by (internal_ip, node) (kube_node_info))) - sum by (node) (container_memory_working_set_bytes{container!="",pod!=""}) - max by (node) (container_memory_working_set_bytes{job="kubelet",systemd_service="k3s"}), 0)
sum by (node) (label_replace(node_memory_MemAvailable_bytes, "internal_ip", "$1", "instance", "([^:]+):.*") * on (internal_ip) group_left (node) max by (internal_ip, node) (kube_node_info))
(sum by (node) (kube_node_status_capacity{resource="memory"}) - sum by (node) (kube_node_status_allocatable{resource="memory"}))

sum by (node) (((kube_pod_container_resource_requests{resource="memory",node!=""} * on (namespace, pod) group_left () max by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_status_phase{phase=~"Pending|Running"} == 1)) or (kube_pod_init_container_resource_requests{resource="memory",node!=""} * on (namespace, pod, container) group_left () max by (namespace, pod, container) (kube_pod_init_container_info{restart_policy="Always"}) * on (namespace, pod) group_left () max by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_status_phase{phase=~"Pending|Running"} == 1))))
sum by (node) (kube_node_status_allocatable{resource="memory"})

sum by (node) (kube_node_status_allocatable{resource="memory"}) - sum by (node) (((kube_pod_container_resource_requests{resource="memory",node!=""} * on (namespace, pod) group_left () max by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_status_phase{phase=~"Pending|Running"} == 1)) or (kube_pod_init_container_resource_requests{resource="memory",node!=""} * on (namespace, pod, container) group_left () max by (namespace, pod, container) (kube_pod_init_container_info{restart_policy="Always"}) * on (namespace, pod) group_left () max by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_status_phase{phase=~"Pending|Running"} == 1))))

panels.title: Physical RAM used
panels.description: Out of each node's physical RAM.

targets.expr: (sum by (node) (label_replace(node_memory_MemTotal_bytes, "internal_ip", "$1", "instance", "([^:]+):.*") * on (internal_ip) group_left (node) max by (internal_ip, node) (kube_node_info)) - sum by (node) (label_replace(node_memory_MemAvailable_bytes, "internal_ip", "$1", "instance", "([^:]+):.*") * on (internal_ip) group_left (node) max by (internal_ip, node) (kube_node_info))) / sum by (node) (label_replace(node_memory_MemTotal_bytes, "internal_ip", "$1", "instance", "([^:]+):.*") * on (internal_ip) group_left (node) max by (internal_ip, node) (kube_node_info))

panels.title: Pods' requests out of allocatable
panels.description: Scheduler's view. 100 % = the node takes no more pods.

targets.expr: sum by (node) (((kube_pod_container_resource_requests{resource="memory",node!=""} * on (namespace, pod) group_left () max by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_status_phase{phase=~"Pending|Running"} == 1)) or (kube_pod_init_container_resource_requests{resource="memory",node!=""} * on (namespace, pod, container) group_left () max by (namespace, pod, container) (kube_pod_init_container_info{restart_policy="Always"}) * on (namespace, pod) group_left () max by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_status_phase{phase=~"Pending|Running"} == 1)))) / sum by (node) (kube_node_status_allocatable{resource="memory"})

panels.title: Swap used (zram)
panels.description: Compressed swap in RAM. Burstable pods may swap; growth means the node is short of memory.

targets.expr: sum by (node) (label_replace(node_memory_SwapTotal_bytes - node_memory_SwapFree_bytes, "internal_ip", "$1", "instance", "([^:]+):.*") * on (internal_ip) group_left (node) max by (internal_ip, node) (kube_node_info))

panels.title: Memory pressure
panels.description: Share of time processes waited for memory (PSI). Above a few % the node is really short, whatever the numbers above say.

targets.expr: sum by (node) (label_replace(rate(node_pressure_memory_waiting_seconds_total[5m]), "internal_ip", "$1", "instance", "([^:]+):.*") * on (internal_ip) group_left (node) max by (internal_ip, node) (kube_node_info))

panels.title: k3s memory
panels.description: The cgroup k3s.service (k3s and containerd) against its reserve (dashed: kubeReserved + eviction threshold). Above the reserve, k3s eats into the pods' room.

targets.expr: max by (node) (container_memory_working_set_bytes{job="kubelet",systemd_service="k3s"})
(sum by (node) (kube_node_status_capacity{resource="memory"}) - sum by (node) (kube_node_status_allocatable{resource="memory"}))

panels.title: Pods: memory requested and used
panels.description: Requests are VPA's (Goldilocks shows its recommendations). Used: working set now. Far below 100 %: the request holds room the pod does not use; far above: the pod lives on other pods' room.

targets.expr: sum by (namespace, pod, node) (((kube_pod_container_resource_requests{resource="memory",node!=""} * on (namespace, pod) group_left () max by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_status_phase{phase=~"Pending|Running"} == 1)) or (kube_pod_init_container_resource_requests{resource="memory",node!=""} * on (namespace, pod, container) group_left () max by (namespace, pod, container) (kube_pod_init_container_info{restart_policy="Always"}) * on (namespace, pod) group_left () max by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_status_phase{phase=~"Pending|Running"} == 1))))
sum by (namespace, pod, node) (container_memory_working_set_bytes{container!="",pod!=""})

sum by (namespace, pod, node) (container_memory_working_set_bytes{container!="",pod!=""}) / sum by (namespace, pod, node) (((kube_pod_container_resource_requests{resource="memory",node!=""} * on (namespace, pod) group_left () max by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_status_phase{phase=~"Pending|Running"} == 1)) or (kube_pod_init_container_resource_requests{resource="memory",node!=""} * on (namespace, pod, container) group_left () max by (namespace, pod, container) (kube_pod_init_container_info{restart_policy="Always"}) * on (namespace, pod) group_left () max by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_status_phase{phase=~"Pending|Running"} == 1))))
sum by (namespace, pod, node) (kube_pod_container_resource_limits{resource="memory"})

panels.title: CPU now
panels.description: Cores, 5-minute average. The bar is the node's cores.

targets.expr: sum by (node) (rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{container!="",pod!=""}[5m]))
max by (node) (rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{job="kubelet",systemd_service="k3s"}[5m]))

clamp_min(sum by (node) (label_replace(rate(node_cpu_seconds_total{mode!~"idle|iowait|steal"}[5m]), "internal_ip", "$1", "instance", "([^:]+):.*") * on (internal_ip) group_left (node) max by (internal_ip, node) (kube_node_info)) - sum by (node) (rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{container!="",pod!=""}[5m])) - max by (node) (rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{job="kubelet",systemd_service="k3s"}[5m])), 0)

clamp_min(count by (node) (label_replace(node_cpu_seconds_total{mode="idle"}, "internal_ip", "$1", "instance", "([^:]+):.*") * on (internal_ip) group_left (node) max by (internal_ip, node) (kube_node_info)) - sum by (node) (label_replace(rate(node_cpu_seconds_total{mode!~"idle|iowait|steal"}[5m]), "internal_ip", "$1", "instance", "([^:]+):.*") * on (internal_ip) group_left (node) max by (internal_ip, node) (kube_node_info)), 0)

sum by (node) (label_replace(rate(node_cpu_seconds_total{mode!~"idle|iowait|steal"}[5m]), "internal_ip", "$1", "instance", "([^:]+):.*") * on (internal_ip) group_left (node) max by (internal_ip, node) (kube_node_info)) / count by (node) (label_replace(node_cpu_seconds_total{mode="idle"}, "internal_ip", "$1", "instance", "([^:]+):.*") * on (internal_ip) group_left (node) max by (internal_ip, node) (kube_node_info))

panels.title: Pods' CPU requests out of allocatable

targets.expr: sum by (node) (((kube_pod_container_resource_requests{resource="cpu",node!=""} * on (namespace, pod) group_left () max by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_status_phase{phase=~"Pending|Running"} == 1)) or (kube_pod_init_container_resource_requests{resource="cpu",node!=""} * on (namespace, pod, container) group_left () max by (namespace, pod, container) (kube_pod_init_container_info{restart_policy="Always"}) * on (namespace, pod) group_left () max by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_status_phase{phase=~"Pending|Running"} == 1)))) / sum by (node) (kube_node_status_allocatable{resource="cpu"})

panels.title: CPU throttling
panels.description: Pods held back by their CPU limit (share of periods throttled). Only pods with a CPU limit show.

targets.expr: topk(5, sum by (namespace, pod) (rate(container_cpu_cfs_throttled_periods_total{container!=""}[5m])) / sum by (namespace, pod) (rate(container_cpu_cfs_periods_total{container!=""}[5m]))) > 0.01

panels.title: Pods: CPU requested and used
panels.description: Cores. Used: 5-minute average.

targets.expr: sum by (namespace, pod, node) (((kube_pod_container_resource_requests{resource="cpu",node!=""} * on (namespace, pod) group_left () max by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_status_phase{phase=~"Pending|Running"} == 1)) or (kube_pod_init_container_resource_requests{resource="cpu",node!=""} * on (namespace, pod, container) group_left () max by (namespace, pod, container) (kube_pod_init_container_info{restart_policy="Always"}) * on (namespace, pod) group_left () max by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_status_phase{phase=~"Pending|Running"} == 1))))
sum by (namespace, pod, node) (rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{container!="",pod!=""}[5m]))

panels.title: Root filesystem used
panels.description: local-path volumes, images and logs share it.

targets.expr: max by (node) (label_replace(1 - node_filesystem_avail_bytes{mountpoint="/"} / node_filesystem_size_bytes{mountpoint="/"}, "internal_ip", "$1", "instance", "([^:]+):.*") * on (internal_ip) group_left (node) max by (internal_ip, node) (kube_node_info))
max by (namespace, persistentvolumeclaim) (kubelet_volume_stats_used_bytes{job="kubelet"} / kubelet_volume_stats_capacity_bytes{job="kubelet"})

panels.title: Network, public interface
panels.description: eth0: in above zero, out below.

targets.expr: sum by (node) (label_replace(rate(node_network_receive_bytes_total{device="eth0"}[5m]), "internal_ip", "$1", "instance", "([^:]+):.*") * on (internal_ip) group_left (node) max by (internal_ip, node) (kube_node_info))

-sum by (node) (label_replace(rate(node_network_transmit_bytes_total{device="eth0"}[5m]), "internal_ip", "$1", "instance", "([^:]+):.*") * on (internal_ip) group_left (node) max by (internal_ip, node) (kube_node_info))
